# Living Cities

> Living Cities is a philanthropic collaboration of foundations and financial institutions working to close racial wealth gaps in U.S. cities through initiatives in entrepreneurship, homeownership, venture capital, and narrative change.

Living Cities brings together member organizations to address systemic inequities in wealth and capital allocation across major U.S. cities including Atlanta, Austin, Albuquerque, Charlotte, Memphis, Minneapolis, and Nashville. The organization operates through strategic initiatives like the Closing the Gaps Network, Business Starts & Growth, and the Center for Wealth Equity, with a focus on supporting BIPOC entrepreneurs, homeowners, and fund managers.

## Key Topics

- Racial equity
- Wealth gap closing
- Entrepreneurship support
- Homeownership
- Venture capital
- Inclusive capital
- Economic development
- Community development
- Affordable housing
- BIPOC-owned businesses
- Capital access
- Narrative change
- Systemic racism
- Local government partnerships
- Wealth building

## About Living Cities

- [Living Cities](https://livingcities.org): Living Cities homepage: philanthropic collaboration closing racial wealth gaps in U.S. cities
- [About - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/about): Living Cities mission, values, and approach to closing wealth gaps in U.S. cities
- [Our Work - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/work): Overview of Living Cities initiatives including Closing the Gaps Network and Business Starts & Growth
- [Our People - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/our-people): Living Cities staff directory and leadership team including executive leadership structure
- [Our Members - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/our-members): Living Cities member organizations including foundations and financial institutions collaborating on wealth equity

## Core Initiatives

- [Closing the Gaps Network - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/initiative/closing-the-gaps-network): Closing the Gaps Network: anti-racism initiative across Albuquerque, Atlanta, Austin and more
- [Center for Wealth Equity - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/initiative/center-for-wealth-equity): Center for Wealth Equity initiative focused on systemic change in wealth and capital allocation
- [Year of Reckoning - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/initiative/year-of-reckoning): Year of Reckoning initiative addressing systemic racism in homeownership and BIPOC businesses
- [Breaking Barriers to Business - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/initiative/breaking-barriers-to-business): Breaking Barriers to Business initiative with Truist Foundation supporting small business in Southeast
- [Business Starts and Growth - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/initiative/business-starts-and-growth): Business Starts and Growth program supporting entrepreneurship in underrepresented communities

## Focus Areas

- [Business Ownership - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/focus-area/entrepreneurship): Business Ownership focus area covering minority-owned businesses and capital access initiatives
- [Venture Capital and Private Equity - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/focus-area/venture-capital): Venture Capital focus area including Catalyst Fund supporting BIPOC fund managers and social impact
- [Homeownership & City Engagement - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/focus-area/homeownership): Homeownership focus area addressing racial equity and affordable housing in cities like Albuquerque
- [Narrative Change - Living Cities](https://livingcities.org/focus-area/narrative-change): Narrative Change focus area using storytelling to address capital access and racial equity
